item.title: Acknowledgements
item.dc:creator: Delaram Bameri
item.description:
This course was organized by MedBioInfo, the Swedish National Graduate School in Medical Bioinformatics, which provides advanced national training in medical bioinformatics for PhD students across Sweden’s universities.

If you’re a PhD student working in bioinformatics or computational life science, MedBioInfo is genuinely worth looking into. Beyond a full menu of short, advanced courses (typically 3–5 HP each, delivered in sequence throughout the programme), you get a national peer group of fellow PhD students, a faculty mentor who adds perspective beyond your own supervisor, and annual meetings packed with faculty talks, research presentations, workshops, and networking.

Speaking from experience: it’s not just about the coursework. I’ve built contacts nationwide and made friendships along the way. It’s a genuinely friendly environment where you learn and train professionally while still enjoying being a PhD student, which isn’t always a given.

If this sounds like something you’d want to be part of, visit the MedBioInfo website for details on applying, or reach out to Samuel Flores with any questions.

Welcome to my blog for the reproducible reaserch course!
